metadata.title: Basic Arithmetic Recall Quiz for Model Switch Smoke Test (TST101)
metadata.instructions: Answer each question briefly. Each question carries 1 mark. Choose the correct answer or write the required number.

questions.question_text: In the assessment activity breakdown, what is the total percentage allocated to the 'Analyze' activity?
